## Plan
### Ontology (additive; regenerate ontology/generated)
1. common.yaml: add `is_a` abstract-parent linkage to the 4 i18n enums; ADD non-US national children (fr/uk/de/eu) under shared abstract parents. NO new us.* value. LinkML PV supports is_a (verified, linkml_runtime 1.11.1).
   - AcquisitionMethod: link us.foia/us.state_public_records/fr.cada/uk.foi/eu.access_to_documents is_a records_request.
   - LegalInstrumentType: add fr.arrete_prefectoral(is_a prefectoral_order), fr.cnil_decision(is_a dpa_decision), uk.surveillance_camera_code(is_a code_of_practice), eu.ai_act(is_a regulation), de.landesdatenschutzgesetz(is_a statute).
   - JurisdictionType: fr.region(is_a state_province), fr.departement(is_a county), fr.commune(is_a municipality), fr.epci(is_a metropolitan_area), uk.police_force_area(is_a special_district), de.bundesland(is_a state_province), de.kreis(is_a county), de.gemeinde(is_a municipality).
   - OrganizationType: add abstract parent `law_enforcement`; link us.le.* is_a law_enforcement; add uk.territorial_police, de.landespolizei is_a law_enforcement (fr.police_municipale/fr.gendarmerie already present -> link is_a law_enforcement).
2. entities.yaml: add `transliteration_scheme` (string, multivalued) to Jurisdiction + Organization (SIG-ONTO-069).
3. generate.py build_structural_skos: emit skos:broader for pv.is_a; topConceptOf only when no parent. Byte-deterministic.

### Policy — the adapter framework (SIG-CHART-029/030)
4. policy/src/policy/jurisdiction.py: JurisdictionAdapter dataclass (levels, code schemes, org types, legal instrument types, records-request methods, default_languages, transliteration_schemes, publication_profile, local_partner); CHECKLIST_ITEMS; adapter_checklist(); assert_no_us_shaped_assumption(); validate_adapter(); load_adapters().
5. policy/src/policy/data/jurisdiction_adapters.toml: US-DEFAULT + FR + GB + DE adapters (data).
6. policy/cli.py: add `sig-policy jurisdiction` subcommand (validate all adapters + print checklist).

### Coarse international ingestion (SIG-ENG-036 / SIG-INGEST-042)
7. connectors/src/connectors/coarse_international.py: coarse_claim() emitting granularity=country|vendor, subject at jurisdiction/vendor level; DisaggregationError guard refusing agency-level disaggregation.
8. connectors/data/sources.toml: register carnegie_ai_gsi, facial_recognition_world_map, aspi_mapping_chinas_tech_giants (LINK/UNDETERMINED, §22.7).
